You worry me sometimes.|Kanan Jarrus and Ezra Bridger|}} '''The Inquisitor's TIE Advanced''' was the personal [[TIE/ad v1]] prototype [[TIE Advanced x1|TIE fighter]] entrusted to [[the Grand Inquisitor]] in his mission to [[Great Jedi Purge|hunt down]] [[Jedi]] for the [[Galactic Empire]]. ==Characteristics== This TIE/ad was equipped with a [[cockpit]] access hatch, targeting sensors and [[solar collector]]s. Its special folding wings allowed it greater speed than the 1,200 [[Kilometer per hour|kph]] of a standard TIE fighter. It boasted an armament of two [[laser cannon]]s and could carry up to 20 [[missile]] shells. Unlike the production version of the v1, the Inquisitor's personal ship also had life support in the cockpit, allowing it to be flown without a flight suit if desired. Unlike most other TIE models, the v1 was outfitted with a hyperdrive and basic shields. ==History== [[File:SWX_2016_World_Championship_Alt_Art_Card_The_Inquisitor.png|thumb|left|250px|The Grand Inquisitor by his TIE]] On the [[Empire Day]] celebration on [[Lothal]] five [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]], the [[Inquisitorius|Inquisitor]] used it to pursue rogue Jedi [[Padawan]] [[Kanan Jarrus]] and the [[Spectres]] after a [[Bombing at the Empire Day parade|"terrorist attack"]] in [[Capital City]]. Later, following the Inquisitor's [[death]] [[Action at Mustafar|aboard]] the ''[[Sovereign]]'', Jarrus and [[Ezra Bridger]] stole it to escape the exploding [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] and rejoin with their own [[Ghost|transport]]. According to [[General]] [[Antoc Merrick]], following the action at [[Mustafar]], [[Capin Harinar]] and his crew had a merry [[time]] taking the [[Starship|ship]] apart.''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' ==Behind the scenes== In 2014, Hasbro made a toy of the Inquisitor's TIE advanced prototype as part of their Saga legends/Rebels line. There are 2 variants, one with green missiles and one with red. ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Head to Head]]'' gives the length of a TIE/ad v1 as 3.57 [[meter]]s, but ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Beware the Inquisitor!]]'' states that the Inquisitor's TIE measures 9.2 meters in length. This article assumes the former source correct. {{Ship-stub}} ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars: Starfighter Missions]]'' *{{Rebels|Empire Day (episode)}} {{1st}} *''[[Ezra's Duel with Danger]]'' *{{Rebels|Gathering Forces}} *{{Rebels|Fire Across the Galaxy}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *{{LegoMagazineCite|club=1|issue=September/October 2015|story=Rebel Ruse!}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Visual Guide]]'' *''[[Ultimate Sticker Collection: Star Wars Rebels]]'' {{1stID|The Inquisitor's TIE Advanced}} *{{InsiderCite|152|Blaster}} *''[[Star Wars Rebels: Head to Head]]'' *{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars Rebels (toy line)|pack=The Inquisitor's TIE Advanced Prototype|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Rebels-Vehicles-series-1-Inquisitors-TIE-Advanced-Prototype.asp}} *{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars Rebels (toy line)|pack=The ''Phantom'' Attack Shuttle|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Rebels-Vehicles-series-1-The-Phantom-Attack-Shuttle.asp}} *''[[Star Wars Rebels: Beware the Inquisitor!]]'' *{{LEGOCite|num=75082|name=TIE Advanced Prototype}} *{{InsiderCite|156|Star Wars Rebels Recounted|''Star Wars Rebels'' Recounted|reprint=1}} {{Po}} *''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'' *{{FFGXW|set=Inquisitor's TIE Expansion Pack}} *{{SWIA|set=The Grand Inquisitor Villain Pack}} {{1stID|the Grand Inquisitor's TIE}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' {{Imo}} *{{SW|url=news/andor-trivia-guide-week-1|text=Secrets from the Set of ''Andor'' Season 2: Week 1 Trivia}} *{{Databank|imperial-xx-23-s-thread-tracer|Imperial XX-23 S-Thread Tracer}} *{{Databank|inquisitor-s-tie-advanced-prototype|Inquisitor's TIE Advanced Prototype}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=TIE Avanzado del Inquisidor |ja=尋問官のTIEアドバンスト }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Inquisitor's TIE Advanced}} [[Category:Captured starships]] [[Category:Starships of the Inquisitorius]] [[Category:TIE/ad v1s]]
